name: Adam Nkinde
bio: I am Adam, born in Arusha, a city in northern Tanzania. My passion for African wildlife started early in secondary school when I joined environmental conservation clubs. I went on to earn a Diploma in Wildlife Management from the College of African Wildlife and became a certified Wilderness First Aid Responder with CPR training. With extensive training and a deep knowledge of customer care, I am committed to providing the best experience to everyone I meet.
